title: Steer service template
description: Logical structure of a Steer application template (service.template) and its sub-records, GENERATED from the panel model (steer_infra_suite): every property is a real field, with its help text. Templates are authored as Odoo XML; the harness parses the XML into this shape and validates it. CONTRACT VERSIONING: 'x-schema-version' is the version of THIS contract (not the app's 'version' label). A template MAY declare which contract version it targets with an XML comment '<!-- steer-schema-version: 1.1 -->'; the harness rejects a version it does not support. No marker = assumed current.

code.description: Unique template code (used internally) Unique across the whole catalog; lowercase snake/kebab-case.

service_code.description: Groups mutually compatible applications to restore cross backups (e.g. "odoo-19"). Apps with the same Service Code generate and restore backups the same way. If left empty, the app is only compatible with itself.

version.description: Human-readable version of the packaged application shown in the catalog (e.g. "19.0", "16.6", "stable"). It distinguishes templates that share the same Service Code (e.g. Odoo 17 vs Odoo 19). It is a label only: it does NOT affect the deployment fingerprint (see "Content hash").

description.description: Short one-line summary shown on the catalog card and in search.

rich_description.description: Full professional HTML description shown on the application page (curated, first-party content — rendered as-is).

source_url.description: Source code repository (e.g. GitHub/GitLab/Gitea) of the upstream project.

is_hidden.description: If True, the template is not shown in the listing (system templates)

allowed_production.description: Allow using this template in production environments

allowed_staging.description: Allow using this template in staging environments

allowed_development.description: Allow using this template in development environments

has_integrated_ide.description: Indicates that this template includes an integrated IDE (code-server) for development.

health_check_command.description: Command for the Docker healthcheck of the main service (e.g.: curl -f http://localhost:8069/web/health)

extra_capabilities.description: Comma-separated Linux capabilities to grant back on top of the default hardening baseline (cap_drop:[ALL] + a minimal safe set: CHOWN, SETUID, SETGID, NET_BIND_SERVICE, etc.). Only list what your image additionally needs, e.g.: NET_RAW (ping healthcheck), NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE.

is_web_app.description: If active, this application will be accessible via HTTP/HTTPS through Traefik

database_is_external.description: The database is not a stack container but an external server (e.g. SQL Server on-premise of the client). SQL commands are run via sqlcmd against the external host (db_host/db_port/db_instance variables), not via "docker compose exec db".

use_cloudflare_tunnel.description: Exposes the instances through a Cloudflare tunnel (cloudflared) instead of Traefik. For servers without a public IP (on-premise).

sql_databases_template.description: Jinja expression that, rendered with the instance variables, returns the databases on which SQL commands are run by default (names separated by comma or line break). It is rendered with the same context as docker_compose_template (direct access to the variables, e.g. {{ db_wincampo }}). Empty = classic behavior (a single database).

sql_audit_check_template.description: Jinja SQL run on the target database BEFORE everything, to decide whether the command was already applied (idempotency). It must print the __STEER_APPLIED__ token when already applied (and nothing otherwise). Empty = it is not checked (always runs).

sql_audit_pre_template.description: Jinja SQL run on the target database BEFORE each NON readonly command (e.g. INSERT of the record in PENDING state). Empty = no log.

sql_audit_post_template.description: Jinja SQL run on the target database AFTER each NON readonly command (e.g. UPDATE of the record to OK/ERROR). Extra context: success (bool), error_output. Empty = no log.

backup_mode.description: Standard: compresses the entire service folder. Custom: uses defined scripts.

backup_tolerate_live_files.description: Treat tar's 'file changed as we read it' warning as success (hot copy). Enable ONLY for stores that keep rewriting files while running and support live volume copies — Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, etc. NEVER enable it for databases: a hot copy of live database files is corrupt — use a database dump (Custom backup mode) instead.

backup_script.description: Bash script to create the backup file. It only handles data, not the service.

restore_script.description: Bash script to restore data from backup. The system handles starting/stopping the service.

resource_limits_default.description: Instances deployed from this template are created with "Limit Resources" already on, so they get the per-service limits declared below. Turn it on for templates whose services are sized here; leave it off for stacks that must use whatever the host has free (monitoring, for example). It only sets the initial value: each instance can be switched afterwards.

rollback_unsafe.description: Updating this app migrates its database (e.g. Odoo -u, Laravel migrate): putting the previous code back over the migrated schema can do more harm than the failed update. With this flag the automatic rollback never fires for its instances; a failed update only notifies and leaves the manual rollback available.

tags.description: Catalog tags (xmlids of steer_infra_suite.tag_*, without the module prefix).

code.description: Port identifier (e.g.: http, longpolling, ws). Used as PORT_CODE in Docker

default_port.description: Suggested port (reference only, the real one is auto-assigned on the instance)

is_fixed.description: If active, the port is not auto-assigned and always uses the default value. Useful for system services such as the reverse proxy.

expose_to_host.description: If active, the port is mapped to the host in docker-compose. If disabled, it is only accessible via the Docker network (Traefik).

traefik_routed.description: If active, Traefik will create a router for this port.

traefik_path_prefix.description: Path prefix for routing (e.g.: /websocket). Empty = catch-all of the domain.

traefik_strip_prefix.description: If active, Traefik strips the prefix before forwarding to the container.

traefik_subdomain_suffix.description: Suffix for an additional subdomain (e.g.: -ide, -api). Generates {subdomain}{suffix}.{domain} as a separate route.

traefik_docker_service.description: Name of the service in docker-compose where to inject Traefik labels. Empty = main service. E.g.: headscale-admin

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS on the subdomain routed by this port (Traefik accesscontrolalloworiginlist label), comma-separated. Empty = only the main domain of the service (default behavior). Use "*" to allow any origin (needed e.g. for hybrid mobile apps/WebView that send Origin http://localhost or capacitor://localhost).

health_check_path.description: Path the panel probes to decide if this subdomain is up (e.g.: /health). Empty = root "/". Useful for services that do not serve "/" (a WebSocket/Socket.IO or an API returns 404 on "/" although it is alive) — point it to a route that answers 2xx.

prometheus_scrape.description: If active, the monitoring stack scrapes this port as a Prometheus exporter. For remote scrape via VPN, also check "Expose to Host".

prometheus_job.description: Name of the job under which the targets of this exporter are grouped (e.g.: postgres, mssql, redis, myapp). Empty = the port code is used. Reserved: prometheus, node, cadvisor, traefik, blackbox, loki.

metrics_path.description: HTTP path where the exporter exposes the metrics (default /metrics).

metrics_container_suffix.description: Suffix of the container that exposes the metrics, for the LOCAL scrape via DNS ({INSTANCE_CODE}{suffix}). Empty = main container ({INSTANCE_CODE}). E.g.: -pgexporter for a postgres-exporter sidecar.

help.description: Additional help text for the user

required.description: If enabled, the deploy requires a value for this variable (validated in the deploy wizard).

is_secret.description: If secret, it will not be shown in logs

var_type.description: «Password» auto-generates a random secure password on deploy. «Secret Key (Fernet)» auto-generates a valid Fernet master key (base64 url-safe, 32 bytes) — use it for STEER_SECRET_KEY when a deployed service is itself a panel: the value is generated once per instance, kept encrypted and re-injected on every redeploy (stable, so it never breaks the child's at-rest secrets). Both are treated as secret (masked in logs, written to the runtime .env, not inlined).

is_version_variable.description: Indicates that this variable tracks the version/tag of a Docker image

owner.description: UID:GID format (e.g.: 100:101 for Odoo, 999:999 for PostgreSQL)

is_log_folder.description: Check if this volume stores logs. Allows cleaning it from the cleanup wizard.

exclude_from_backup.description: Exclude this directory from file backups. Use for data requiring a special dump (e.g.: PostgreSQL data).

allow_file_management.description: Allows uploading, downloading and deleting files from the instance. Only enable on safe directories (e.g.: db-backups, uploads).

name.description: Descriptive name of the file (e.g.: PostgreSQL Config)

filename.description: Name of the file to generate (e.g.: postgresql.conf, .env, config.ini)

path.description: Relative path from the service directory (e.g.: ./, ./config/, ./etc/)

content_template.description: File content with Jinja2 syntax. Same variables as Docker Compose.

syntax_mode.description: Syntax highlighting mode in the editor

skip_update.description: If active, the file is only created on the first deploy. Updates/Redeploys do not overwrite it. Useful for externally managed files (e.g.: ACL policies).

is_executable.description: Writes the file with mode 755 instead of 644. Needed for scripts a container runs at startup (e.g. hooks in /custom-cont-init.d, which are skipped if they are not executable).

active.description: If disabled, the file will not be generated

service_name.description: Name of the service in docker-compose (e.g.: db, odoo, redis)

log_max_file.description: Maximum number of rotated log files

stop_grace_period.description: Seconds Docker waits for this service to shut down cleanly before SIGKILL. Overrides the instance default for stateful services (databases). Leave at 0 to use the instance default.

name.description: Label of the button on the instance (e.g.: "Update Odoo")

code.description: Unique identifier of the action within the template (snake_case)

description.description: Descriptive text of what the action does

icon.description: FontAwesome icon for the button (e.g.: fa-arrow-up, fa-refresh)

command.description: Bash command to run in the service directory. Supports Jinja2 with the same context as the configuration files (instance, variables, PORT_*, base_path). The value entered by the user is available as {{ input_quoted }} (quoted with shlex, shell-safe — use this one) or {{ input }} (raw, only for advanced uses such as $(cat file)).

target_service.description: Name of the affected service in docker-compose (e.g.: odoo). Used to stop/start around the command.

pull_repositories.description: Before running the command, does a "git pull" of all the repositories associated with the instance.

backup_before.description: Creates a backup of the instance before running the action. "Only in production" does it only if the environment is production.

stop_service_before.description: Runs "docker compose stop <service>" before the command

start_service_after.description: Runs "docker compose start <service>" when the command finishes

timeout.description: Maximum command execution time in seconds

requires_confirmation.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before running

requires_input.description: Requests a value from the user before running (available as {{ input }})

input_label.description: Label of the input field (e.g.: "Modules to update")

input_multiline.description: If active, the parameter is entered in a text area

available_states.description: States of the instance (comma-separated) in which the button appears. Empty = in all states. E.g.: running,stopped,error

clone_path.description: Relative path where to clone the repository (e.g.: ./app, ./frontend, ./config)
